stories.title: Prep Rally Honor Roll (11/17/26) | VOTE NOW
stories.summary: Watch the best Colorado high school sports moments of the week and vote for your favorite in the 9NEWS Prep Rally Honor Roll.

stories.title: Denver Fire Weather Watch Wednesday ahead of mountain storm and snow
stories.summary: Approaching storm to bring high winds and light mountain snow. The National Weather Service issues a High Wind Warning for the Front Range Mountains and Foothills

stories.title: District attorney releases timeline of events and justifies officer's use of force in CSU shooting
stories.summary: A judge has ordered Brooks Bottenhorn, 22, to stay away from campus. He's also prohibited from possessing weapons, drugs or alcohol and was released on bond.

stories.title: Man convicted, sentenced for murdering man and lighting his body on fire
stories.summary: Gerardo Hernandez-Lucio was shot and killed in LaSalle. Days later, his body was set on fire under a bridge near Stevens Gulch Picnic Site.

stories.title: Wolf brought to Colorado from Canada dies in Utah
stories.summary: Colorado Parks said the female gray wolf traveled 9,000 miles on her own across Colorado and into neighboring states over 18 months.

stories.title: Suns beat Nuggets for their 1st road win of the season
stories.summary: Devin Booker led seven Phoenix players in doubles figures with 20 points and the Suns beat the Nuggets for their first road win of the season.

stories.title: All Elite Wrestling returns to Denver with 'Dynamite'
stories.summary: All Elite Wrestling is heading back to the Mile High City. AEW Dynamite kicks off the Continental Classic at Mission Ballroom.

stories.title: 9Cares Colorado Shares food drive aims to combat hunger across the state
stories.summary: The 9Cares Colorado Shares food drive supports five food banks, providing meals to struggling families. One in eight Coloradans face food insecurity.

stories.title: Jhené Aiko, H.E.R. announce Denver arena concert
stories.summary: Jhené Aiko announces her "Ark to Agartha" tour with stops across North America in 2027, featuring special guests like H.E.R., Swae Lee, and Karri.

stories.title: Here's the holiday season TV schedule on NBC
stories.summary: NBC unveils its holiday 2026 schedule, featuring the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade and new specials like “Christmas With Snoop Dogg.”

stories.title: Inscribed knife found near where skeletal remains were discovered at Colorado state park
stories.summary: Authorities are asking for help identifying a knife found with a pair of pants near where skeletal remains were discovered at Chatfield State Park.

stories.title: Red Rocks concert season ends: Here's who's coming in 2027
stories.summary: Red Rocks Amphitheatre is set to kick off a spectacular 2027 concert season, featuring performances by Megadeth, Sam Fender, and Killer Queen.
